items.text: Not much optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he won’t go. Rams get Puka Nacua back.
items.why: Hamstring; sources to McManus/Garafolo/Schefter little optimism.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thinned; targets to others. Nacua boosts Rams.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Eagles WRs/TEs if Smith out; Nacua full role

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss at least 4 games (eligible Week 9 with bye).
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 3; coach confirmed IR.
items.implication: Saints backfield becomes committee; Etienne out multi weeks.

items.text: Steelers rule out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) for TNF vs Browns; Joey Porter Jr also out.
items.implication: Clears path for Warren lead role.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play this week; 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out. Believe in him on short week TNF.
items.why: Elite snap/touch share with Dowdle OUT (toe); short week risk but usage overrides.

items.text: Ravens Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full participation on Thursday injury report.
items.implication: Both expected to play at full capacity vs Titans.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles; full participant Thursday.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Rams passing game and Nacua fantasy value.

items.text: De'Von Achane officially out for season torn ACL; ETR waiver lists Ollie Gordon II as primary beneficiary.
items.implication: Dolphins RB reset; desperation adds only.

items.text: ETR waiver: Travis Etienne IR beneficiaries Alvin Kamara (led 50% snaps post-exit) and Kendre Miller (30%); expect committee, Kamara low-end flex.
items.why: Post-Etienne snap split; not pure feature.
items.implication: Kamara preferred but committee limits upside.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ankle injury does not sound serious; ran just two routes before injury (2-32-0) in limited action.
items.why: Limited routes data + injury not serious per Levitan; DNP but day-to-day.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential return Week 4 vs MIA.
items.opportunity: If active, high target share resumes

items.text: Drake London shines in Michael Penix Jr. return (Week 3 storyline); Berry notes Pitts low with Penix historically but London elevated.
items.why: Strong performance with Penix back; contrast to Pitts 16% TS career with him.
items.opportunity: High target share routes with Penix

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS Top 150: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall; Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30 notable.
items.why: Updated for injuries/roles/schedule; Walker elite ROS.
items.implication: Hold/trade up for Walker; Washington breakout candidate.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst results relative to opportunity so far.
items.why: Low targets/aDOT despite opportunity; underperformed chart leader.
items.implication: TE fade until volume improves with Penix.
items.conflict: Berry notes low target share historically with Penix
corroboration: Berry 10 Facts Pitts 16% TS with Penix

items.text: Brock Bowers shreds in season debut (43% target share, perfect Util 100 per Berry); key Week 3 storyline ahead of Week 4.
items.why: High target share true WR role in return.

items.text: Dallas Goedert will miss a few weeks with MCL sprain; enough to drop for plug-and-play TE options like Sadiq/Waller.
